package.description: A neat little application that allows you to draw on your screen

en-US.description: A neat little application that allows you to draw on your screen
en-US.longDescription: iScribby is a screen-drawing application: use it anywhere — on your desktop, while browsing the internet, or even in a video game — to draw, highlight, and annotate directly on the screen during presentations, streams, and lessons.
en-US.name: iScribby

zh-CN.description: 一个能让你直接在屏幕上涂画的精巧小工具
zh-CN.longDescription: iScribby 是一款屏幕涂画应用：无论在桌面、浏览网页还是玩游戏时，都可以用它直接在屏幕上绘制、高亮和标注，非常适合演示、直播和教学场景。
